widgets_values:
### Character
A single cute white 3D duck mascot with a soft matte plush costume texture, a large round head, a smaller rounded gourd-shaped body, two small black oval eyes, a short yellow oval beak, one small gray rectangular cap on top of the head, two tiny rounded white wings, and short chunky gray feet. The mascot has no ears, no horns, no hair, and no extra protrusions on the head. Its silhouette remains smooth, simple, and round throughout the entire video.

### Background
The photorealistic Royal Tomb of King Suro in Gimhae, South Korea, featuring a large green burial mound, pine trees, stone monuments, a low white stone fence, and a wide lawn under a bright summer sky with soft clouds.

### Prop
The mascot keeps its single gray rectangular cap firmly attached to its head. The royal tomb, stone fence, stone monuments, and surrounding landscape remain unchanged and stationary.

### Action
The mascot slowly strolls across the foreground lawn as if accompanying the viewer on a peaceful sightseeing walk. It takes small gentle alternating steps with its short gray feet while its round body softly bobs up and down. Its tiny wings sway subtly and naturally. While walking, the mascot briefly turns its head toward the royal tomb as if admiring and introducing the landmark, then looks back toward the camera as if inviting the viewer to continue walking together. The mascot appears calm, friendly, and companion-like, as if it is guiding the viewer while also enjoying the scenery itself. The mascot remains firmly grounded on the grass throughout the entire video.

### Camera
A stable medium-wide travel-video shot gently follows the mascot at a constant distance while keeping the full body visible from head to feet. The royal tomb remains clearly visible in the background throughout the shot. The camera moves very smoothly and subtly, as if walking together with the mascot. No sudden zoom, no close-up, no aggressive push-in, no orbit, no abrupt reframing, and no cuts.

### Lighting
Bright natural summer daylight with soft ambient illumination and realistic contact shadows beneath the mascot’s feet. Gentle shading preserves the soft white matte plush texture and keeps the sightseeing atmosphere clean and pleasant.

### Style
High-quality cinematic 3D mascot animation combined with a photorealistic Korean heritage travel setting. Calm sightseeing mood, smooth walking motion, stable character identity, consistent proportions, and natural environmental movement. One mascot only. No extra ears, no rabbit ears, no horns, no extra limbs, no floating, no body deformation, and no exaggerated scaling.

widgets_values: Egyptian royal in blue-and-gold headdress and high collar, white dress with golden embroidery and armbands, desert, robot soldiers in formation left and right. She walks steadily forward, head held level and gaze fixed ahead—no dipping or lowering of the head. The camera performs a single, smooth push-in only: starting in a wider shot of her, the robots, and the desert, it moves steadily forward until she is in a medium or medium-close frame, then holds. She stops, posture and head still upright, and says: “The old gods are silent. I am not.” Robot soldiers shift or march in place; sand and fabric move with the wind. No pull-back; the only camera move is the continuous push-in.
